title: ACTUAL SIZE
description: Left: the name and four nav links, the claim in a condensed display face as the largest text, a role line, a three-row proof table (care platform rebuild at Vianova, bayyinahtv.com, Viva Fresh in both stores) and one action. Right: the real care team calendar at actual size, running off the top and right edges, with a mono caption that says how many of the app's 1440 pixels the window shows.
signature: Type: Hubot Sans (local 'Gentrit Display') at width 80, weight 740 for the claim (64 px desktop, 36 px phone), results and headings; Mona Sans ('Gentrit Text') 15–19 px for text; IBM Plex Mono ('Gentrit Technical Mono') 12.5 px for captions, labels and years, tabular. Colour, all from the care app: ground #f5f7fb (its own ground, so screens need no frame), ink oklch(0.25 0.04 235) (its dark teal toward black), one accent #01698f (its primary button: links, the action, focus), one red mark #c81e25 (its current-time line) meaning 'now'. Motion: a quiet layer (press 120 ms, underline 150 ms, instant focus); the one moment is the tile-to-case View Transition, 420 ms expo-out (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1): the window grows from the home crop to the whole 1440-pixel app while no pixel scales.
rule: The page is a window onto the real apps at actual size: every screen is cut to the part that proves its line, never shrunk, and opening a case only opens the window wider.
designRead: Reading this as: a frontend and mobile developer, now full stack, for a hiring manager with two minutes, leading with the care platform rebuild, in a page where every product screen is shown at actual size.
hook: The one where the care app's real screens are shown at actual size, cut off by the page, and opening the case widens the window to the whole app without zooming.
lead: The care platform rebuild (Vianova, 2023–26): the largest checkable change for a hiring manager (a live app moving to React screen by screen while care teams keep using it; one billing report from 16 database requests to 2), with real screens at 2× that stay readable at actual size.
composition: first-screen.md #1, sentence + proof row + one screen, decided by the rule: a 1:1 screen cannot fit, so it takes the right side and runs off the top and right edges; the words get a narrow column, which is why the display face is condensed. The phone row breaks the right-hand column once with three phone screens at real phone width.

fourAnswers.desktop: Gentrit Rashiti (first words of the 64 px claim) / web and phone apps; frontend and mobile developer, now full stack, remote from Kosovo / care teams, learners and shoppers / the real care team calendar at actual size on 57% of the screen, plus a proof table: care platform rebuild at Vianova 2023–26, bayyinahtv.com, Viva Fresh on the App Store and Google Play (all linked)
fourAnswers.phone: Gentrit Rashiti (claim, 4 lines at 36 px) / web and phone apps, role line under it / care teams, learners and shoppers / proof table with the live and store links, then the calendar at actual size from y ≈ 480 with the red now line; the action is just under the fold and the screen itself links to the case

allowed: C08c: phone app screens are drawn at real phone width (390 px), so a store listing file holds about 1.55x, not 2x
T45: the only numbers outside the facts are live measurements in the captions (how many of the app's 1440 pixels the window shows)

holdback: Original, 7: on purpose this is the skill's standard first-screen pattern (claim left, screen right). The rule lives in the scale, the bleed, the measured captions and the crop-opening transition, and the last of these only shows in a live session, not in captures. A reviewer who only reads the PNGs may see a clean, well-set portfolio rather than a decision.
skillNotes: Helped: (1) work-display.md's 'never larger than its pixels; crop, do not shrink; 1:1' was enough to seed the whole rule, and first-screen.md's element table plus the phone rules made the first screen a checklist. (2) writing.md's work-in-progress pattern ('Care teams keep using the app while each screen moves over' + a witnessed proof line) fit the owner rule that 16 → 2 is a proof line, and the word table (query → database request) kept tech words off the home. (3) motion.md's build order (end state first, then cause, then motion, then reduced motion) and the tile-to-case recipe. (4) The checker caught real bugs: my reset `.x h1 {margin:0}` outranked single-class role selectors; the host's @layer base set h1–h4 to Archivo at stretch 112%, so my h3s silently became a fourth family (T18b); 'CV' and inline links under 24 px; 'Services' and 'runtime'. Unclear, wrong or missing: (a) snippets/view-transition.css scales the snapshots (group resize + 100%-width images), which zooms screenshot text; the skill forbids text blur but never shows the no-scale variant: set inline-size/block-size in px on ::view-transition-old/new, overflow:hidden on the image pair, and translate both by the crop-offset difference. It also omits: the name must be on both elements in CSS (the var() sketch needs an inline style), await img.decode() inside the update callback, fall back to a cross-fade when the source tile is off screen, and move focus to the new h1 after the route change. (b) Hard rule 9 says keyboard actions do not animate, while the quiet layer animates 'opening a case'; say whether Enter on a case link animates (I skipped it when event.detail === 0). (c) 'Original or hook ≤ 7 → go back to direct' conflicts with a professional band asked to use the standard first-screen pattern; the skill needs a line on where originality may live inside that pattern (scale, crop, type, one transition). (d) Phone screenshots: 'text ≥ 11 px' and '2× density' conflict for store-listing frames (390 px wide gives 1.55×, 2× gives ~10.8 px text); say which wins. (e) Checker: an inside an overflow:hidden crop window is measured by its full rect, so a below-fold window raised C16c (lazy first-screen image) and inflates C01 unless the window carries data-work; clip rects to the nearest clipping ancestor or document 'mark crop windows with data-work'. T45 has no marker for computed numbers (a live '825 of 1440 pixels' readout needs an allow); a data-measured marker would help. T10b read the app-screen name 'Home' in a phone caption as nav microcopy. The checker changed four times during the round (--owner/--facts first ignored, --list missing, checks.md appearing, C02 phone budget 70 → 90, T12c/T23 rules rewritten), so verdicts moved under unchanged pages. (f) Fonts: neither 'swap with a metric fallback' nor 'optional' works for a condensed display face on a cold headless run (optional keeps the fallback in every capture; swap reflows a 4-line claim). Gating the first render on document.fonts.load with a 700 ms cap gave CLS 0; the skill could offer that pattern. (g) The case template's facts row 'Role · Years · Platforms · Live' has three middots, which T30 flags; a dl is the safer default and the template should say so.
